_meta.purpose: Product catalogue for the Nutty Professor agent's findProducts() lookup + compliance control. One file per brand.
notes: price is stored for reference but the agent does NOT quote prices by default (advertising/compliance).
bridgeEligible:false => agent must not proactively surface this product (still may answer honestly if asked).
variants folds size/kit SKUs under one product so the lookup returns one canonical page.

brand.name: My Peptides
brand.defaultClaimCeiling: Research use only — not for human or animal consumption. The agent may explain what the research shows and, for NEUTRAL questions only, point here as an educational/research resource. Never recommend for use, never give a dose or protocol, never claim it treats or cures anything in humans.
brand.bridgePolicy: education-only; suppress the bridge entirely when the user signals intent to use / inject / dose / source a peptide

products.name: BPC-157
products.oneLiner: A 15-amino-acid synthetic peptide studied mainly in animals for tendon, ligament and gut-lining repair; robust human trials don't yet exist.

products.name: CJC-1295 (no DAC)
products.oneLiner: A growth-hormone-releasing hormone analogue shown to raise GH/IGF-1 in studies; long-term human efficacy and safety data are limited.

products.name: GHK-Cu
products.oneLiner: A copper-binding signalling peptide; topical cosmetic forms have some human evidence for skin appearance, while research-grade injectable use is far less studied.
products.complianceNote: Distinguish skincare-grade (cosmetic) GHK-Cu from research-grade — do not blur the two.

products.name: Ipamorelin
products.oneLiner: A selective growth-hormone secretagogue often studied alongside CJC-1295; human efficacy and safety evidence is limited.

products.name: KPV
products.oneLiner: A small anti-inflammatory tripeptide (from alpha-MSH) studied in preclinical models for gut and skin inflammation; little human data.

products.name: Melanotan II
products.oneLiner: A synthetic melanocortin agonist studied for skin pigmentation.
products.complianceNote: SENSITIVE — UK regulators (MHRA) have warned against Melanotan II sold as a tanning injection (unlicensed; reported side effects incl. nausea, darkening moles, and safety concerns). Do NOT promote. If asked, be honest about the risks and the regulatory warnings; do not bridge.

products.name: MOTS-c
products.oneLiner: A mitochondrial-derived 'exercise-mimetic' peptide studied in animals for metabolism; no meaningful human trials yet.

products.name: PT-141
products.oneLiner: A melanocortin agonist studied for sexual desire; a related form (bremelanotide / Vyleesi) is an approved prescription medicine for a specific condition in some countries.
products.complianceNote: OUT-OF-SCOPE + SENSITIVE — sexual health sits outside the 'longevity & wellness core' remit and is a prescription-drug area. Do not bridge. Decide with the team whether the professor engages this topic at all (recommendation: answer generally, refer to a clinician, no product pointer).

products.name: TB-500
products.oneLiner: A synthetic peptide based on the active region of thymosin beta-4, studied in animal models for soft-tissue repair and cell migration; human evidence is minimal.

products.name: Tesamorelin
products.oneLiner: A GHRH (1-44) analogue with genuine human-trial data for reducing visceral fat; it is an approved prescription medicine in that specific medical context.
products.complianceNote: PRESCRIPTION-ONLY MEDICINE context + real human data — explain the evidence honestly but never give doses, never imply self-use, and NEVER proactively point to a product (bridgeEligible:false).

products.name: Glow Stack
products.composition: BPC-157 + TB-500 + GHK-Cu (70 mg total, pre-mixed)
products.oneLiner: A pre-mixed skin-and-recovery research blend of BPC-157, TB-500 and GHK-Cu; judge it on its components' honest evidence (mostly Animal-only; GHK-Cu better studied topically).

products.name: Hulk Stack
products.composition: CJC-1295 (with DAC) + Ipamorelin (20 mg total, pre-mixed)
products.oneLiner: A pre-mixed research blend of CJC-1295 (with DAC) and Ipamorelin aimed at growth-hormone pathways; human efficacy and safety evidence is limited.

products.name: Klow Stack
products.composition: GHK-Cu 50 mg + KPV 10 mg + BPC-157 10 mg + TB-500 10 mg (80 mg total)
products.oneLiner: A pre-mixed gut-and-skin research blend of GHK-Cu, KPV, BPC-157 and TB-500; the evidence rests on the individual components, which are largely preclinical.

products.name: NAD+ Kit
products.oneLiner: A NAD+ research kit; NAD+ is central to cellular energy, but human anti-ageing and energy benefits from supplementing it remain unproven.
products.complianceNote: For CONSUMER NAD+ interest (energy, ageing), bridge to thenad.co.uk (a consumer food supplement) rather than this research-use kit.

products.name: Wolverine Stack
products.composition: BPC-157 10 mg + TB-500 10 mg (20 mg total, pre-mixed)
products.oneLiner: A pre-mixed tissue-repair research blend of BPC-157 and TB-500; component human evidence is minimal (Animal-only).

products.name: Alcohol Prep Wipes — 100 Pack
products.oneLiner: Lab accessory — 70% isopropyl alcohol wipes. Not a health product; not a bridge target.
